selection.metric: top-1 accuracy, ties by macro-OvR AUC, -EBOPs, -epoch
selection.rule: best checkpoint meeting (a) traced EBOPs <= target, (b) above 0-bit floor, (c) val acc > 0.2109624456315518 (training-batch STUDY.md:995-1012)
selection.health: [A4] healthy = status complete AND feasible_any AND nondegenerate_best AND best_feasible_val_acc >= 0.50 AND attn_entropy_norm_mean < 0.95 (validation), used for r1, bracket, r_rec, W, V_bin, every lead, positive controls, production early stop; acc in (0.2110, 0.50) with entropy < 0.95 = unhealthy 'attentive, low-acc'; W orders by healthy, nondegenerate_best, feasible_any counts, then mean best_feasible_val_acc (null = 0), then lower mean entropy (STUDY.md sections 5, 7)

stop_rules.condition: integrity: any row status != complete (diverged included), backoff exhausted, missing or unexpected row, threshold != 0.2109624456315518, labels sha mismatch, nondegenerate_best without feasible_any
stop_rules.action: autopilot stops and notifies; launches nothing further

stop_rules.condition: entropy-only failure in any round: status complete, feasible_any, nondegenerate_best, best_feasible_val_acc >= 0.50, attn_entropy_norm_mean >= 0.95 (the 0.95 cut is calibrated on A07 only)
stop_rules.action: autopilot stops and notifies Kai before deriving r1/W/V_bin/r_rec or any production candidate; the row is not read as unhealthy and cannot refute H2

stop_rules.condition: [A3] a positive control fails: A07-5000k-C-s1 not healthy, or E-unc-C-s1 not (complete, feasible_any, nondegenerate_best, best_feasible_val_acc >= 0.50) [A4]; an E-unc-C entropy >= 0.95 at acc >= 0.50 is the entropy-only stop, named 'E cut uncalibrated'
stop_rules.action: stop for Kai before any judgement or derivation
